user.title: Google Maps (location sharing)
user.description: Google account that others share their location with. Paste the content of an exported cookies.txt (recommended: Firefox private window). Leave empty to use the existing cookie file, including the one from the old google_maps.

reauth_confirm.title: Google Maps cookies expired
reauth_confirm.description: The session of {account} is no longer valid. Export new cookies and paste them here. Leave empty to re-read the cookie file.

error.invalid_cookies: Invalid cookies or expired session: export them again.
error.no_cookies: No cookies found: paste the content of cookies.txt.

abort.reauth_successful: Cookies updated, Google Maps works again.
